reason: The flagged element is the tabs and table of the ACH Authorizations list that loads after the form, and the accessibility tree ignores it as a plain container. It is page content on a new view, not a status message, and the new PG&E row is visible in the table.
criterionAnalysis: 4.1.3 covers status messages: text that reports a result, state, progress or error without taking focus. The flagged element is part of the ACH Authorizations list page that loads after Authorize, and a new view is a change of context, not a status message. The page also has an empty status region and an empty alert region, so nothing was put in a live region and there is no message to announce. Neither finding claims 1.3.1 or 4.1.2, and the element is an ignored generic container. 2.4.3 would cover focus resetting to body after the route change; neither finding claims it and I did not test it beyond noting focus is on body.
